correctness.rationale: Direct exact-rational differentiation at (u,v)=(1/10,6/5) yields J=[[31/144,-1/24],[45/16,-15/64]], tr=-11/576, determinant 205/3072. Modal trace stays negative; sign of Delta-(a d2+d d1)q+d1 d2 q^2 is the precise strict-linear-instability criterion. For any q0>0, choose d2/d1 just above r_c=((sqrt(Delta)+sqrt(-bc))/a)^2 and set d1=(a r+d)/(2r q0); the negative determinant interval shrinks continuously to q0. Finite spectrum separation proves iff equality of positive support. Exact rational prism and K3,3 Laplacian spectra and both rate-pair signs independently checked; elementary regular graph classification for n<6 proves minimality. Band endpoints with zero determinant are not unstable, and multiplicities are undetectable.

final_claim: For the specified stable predator-prey Jacobian and all finite connected undirected graphs, the full binary strict-linear-Turing-instability response to freely chosen positive diffusivities determines exactly the set of distinct positive graph Laplacian eigenvalues, not their multiplicities. The triangular prism and K3,3 are the smallest equally regular connected graphs allowing the response to reverse in both directions.
limitations: Binary response cannot recover eigenvalue multiplicities, graph isomorphism or nonlinear attractor stability.
